sourceClaims.claim: Table Cell contains 49 source variants with 50px ordinary cell geometry
Table composes source cells into domain examples without defining sorting or selection behavior
the public primitive preserves native table markup and leaves data operations to consumers
Visible Table text is Golos Text Regular 15px/130%/-1%; 14px metadata belongs to non-rendered checkbox labels
Original Table.svg header masks are 50px despite one 48px Figma metadata height
Production header/add-row text uses the existing accessible supporting role; inert diagnostics retain original source gray

evidence.source-integrity: pass: original Table Cell/Table/Icons bytes and exact ZIP tuples are pinned; SVG masks override conflicting 48px metadata
evidence.structural-contract: pass: 5 executable Table roots, 60 inert Table roots and 47 non-Table native tables are explicitly classified
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: native controls and existing Dropdown/Drawer composition drive application-owned sorting/filtering/selection/editing/addition
evidence.accessibility: pass: native captions/headers/names, keyboard/dismissal/disabled behavior, focused axe and production active-text contrast; no blanket WCAG certification
evidence.focused-visual: pass: all source cell geometry/state checks, 31 source composition rows, three focused cell snapshots and 12 actual material-state flows
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace header filters/sort/selection/empty recovery; Pagination consumer follows URLs and changes table rows
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: 320px choice popup is reachable outside the table scroller; long content and selected editing stay native

staticVisual: pass: 49 labelled inert source cells and 31 rows in 10 source composition tables; source paint remains distinct from semantic text corrections
realInteractionVisual: pass: 12 exact-match material states exercise native hover/focus/pressed and consumer-applied styles
runtimeBehavior: pass: consumer-owned data order, conditions, choices, text suggestions, selection, row creation and URL page changes execute

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: inspected original sheets and focused desktop/mobile table surfaces; walked hover/down, Tab/Enter/Space, editing, suggestion/dismissal, disabled add-row and narrow popup reachability

knownLimitations: responsive cards, sticky headers, resizing, virtualization and data operations are unsupported or consumer-owned
Static source compositions are inert recipes, not nine business-specific core components
Popup collision handling and data operations are consumer integrations; Table exports CSS/native markup, no data controller
Overall PR completion remains pending independent review and CI; see table-source-transfer-report.md
